def slugify(text: str) -> str:

    whitespace is collapsed into a single hyphen. Empty or whitespace-only

    """

import re


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert human-readable text to a URL slug.

    Surrounding whitespace is trimmed, text is lowercased, and every run of
    whitespace is collapsed into a single hyphen. Empty or whitespace-only
    input yields an empty string.
    """

    return re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text.strip()).lower()
